instruction: Clone the repository "https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding" to the /home/user directory and verify that the git remote URL is correctly set to the original repository.

metadata.explanation: Task requires cloning a GitHub repository to /home/user directory and verifying the git remote configuration. The evaluator checks: (1) that the repository directory exists at the correct location, (2) that it is a valid git repository, and (3) that the origin remote URL matches the expected GitHub repository URL. Partial credit (0.5) is given if the repository exists and is a valid git repo, and full credit (1.0) if the remote URL also matches.
